verdict.rationale: Network-token management is a fair question for a card-issuing platform, but the pack never documents listing a card's tokens, identifying the wallet or merchant that holds them, or revoking them separately from the PAN. The only related item (lithic-docs-24) says Auth Rules can make decisions on digital wallet and merchant tokenization events. That is an adjacent control, not token lifecycle management, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, network tokens are first-class — I can see and manage the tokens created for a card, know which wallet or merchant holds them, and revoke them independently of the PAN
